scope: Finite neighbourhood, about 72 by 70 metres: two banks, backstreets, bridgeheads and peripheral greens.

browser_checks.manual_walk: Held W for 23 seconds from the original canal street; HUD changed to east-side street and the map moved into the extension.
browser_checks.route_keyboard: During the north-ring tour, ArrowDown on the route select changed to south_ring while tour remained active.
browser_checks.south_tour: Observed progression through west-side street and south residential street. W then handed control to manual walking without resetting location.
browser_checks.full_browser_tour_completion: Not required or claimed; complete paths are covered by the independent mesh audit and navigation sweep tests.
browser_checks.overview_fog: Aerial views use density .0045 for layout inspection; street and walking views retain .008. Both comparison stages use the same values.

limitations: Street structure is completed within the finite district. Newly added architecture and vegetation have simpler detail than the original bookshop core.
Only verified roads, passages and the original courtyard are walkable. House interiors, private gardens, water and distant landscape remain inaccessible.
Navigation uses conservative planar zones and swept obstacle proxies; it is not a full rigid-body physics simulation.
No online publication, asset downloads, installations or changes to existing versions.
